text: Decentralized technology systems require interoperability for survivability, yet most platforms attempt to go it alone in an effort to become the next Bitcoin, so decentralized community silos proliferate and the required infrastructure, which no single protocol can build, does not get built.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Decentralization Neutralizers (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3808873
abstract: Decentralized technology systems require interoperability for survivability. Yet, most platforms attempt to make it alone in an effort to become the next Bitcoin. As a result, decentralized community silos proliferate.
